title: vektor /// no. 036 — Claude Code doesn't know your codebase. Graphify gives it a map.
description: Every new session, Claude Code rebuilds its mental model — the same greps, the same file reads. Graphify builds a knowledge graph it can query instead. The two commands, our own measured run — 196 files, one real question, ≈14× fewer tokens — and the viral numbers we refused to repeat. As promised.
og_title: Claude Code doesn't know your codebase. Graphify gives it a map. — vektor /// no. 036
og_description: The two setup commands, and our own measured receipts: 196 files → a 1,764-node graph, one real query answered in ~2,000 tokens against ~27,184 by reading the files — ≈14×, measured. Plus the viral 70× claim, checked at source.
